objective: Test whether a compact learned process over real-cave cross-section trajectories can add coherent constrictions, chambers, floor-ceiling asymmetry, and wall shape over tens of metres while the accepted Natural regional graph, ports, protected route, surface, forbidden rock, and offline cache contract remain immutable.

motivation_from_cw9.closed_result: CW9 independent two-dimensional high-pass boundary residual learning failed every registered quality promotion gate despite passing runtime and safety gates.
motivation_from_cw9.new_falsifiable_hypothesis: Player-visible cave character is carried more by low-dimensional cross-section morphology evolving coherently along a route than by independent sub-two-metre boundary noise.
motivation_from_cw9.prohibited_reinterpretation: CW11 is a new mechanism study, not a retune or rescue of the failed CW9 validation result.

real_cave_token_dataset.split_unit: entire cave system and acquisition campaign

read_only_representation_audit.interpretation: The registered tangent planes contain a low-dimensional shape signal and neighboring route samples are materially more similar than random samples, so an along-route morphology process is testable.

representation.profile: First outward zero crossing on 32 gravity-anchored radial rays from each protected-route tangent-plane center.
representation.descriptor: Mean log radius plus the first six real Fourier modes of centered log radius; no learned pixel-space encoder in the feasibility phase.
representation.adjacency_pair: Consecutive registered token rows no more than 2m apart with absolute tangent dot product at least 0.5.
representation.source_balance: Estimate statistics within each named cave first and aggregate cave-level statistics with equal weight.
representation.invalid_profile_policy: Exclude from distribution fitting; never impute a target using validation or sealed geometry.

registered_arms.natural_control: Accepted CW10.5 Natural trajectory and contextual per-plane retrieval anatomy.
registered_arms.independent_descriptor_null: The same fitted descriptor distribution sampled independently at every route token.
registered_arms.coherent_statistical_process: A deterministic source-conditioned autoregressive descriptor process using only development-corpus adjacency statistics.
registered_arms.conditional_latent_diffusion: A later compact sequence diffusion model may be trained only if the representation and coherent statistical process pass the feasibility gates.

evaluation.development_cross_validation: Leave one entire named cave out; no token-level random split claims.
visuals: longitudinal radius ribbons showing constrictions and chambers
matched cross-section strips at fixed route distances
evaluation.minecraft_policy: No disposable Minecraft world or client capture until the offline volume passes all hard gates and the owner sees the portable comparison.

runtime_contract.minecraft_consumes: the same hash-verified int8 block cache already proven by CW10

failure_policy.representation_gate_fails: Stop before any neural model and retain Natural unchanged.
failure_policy.statistical_process_fails_visual_or_metr: Do not train latent diffusion on this representation; revise the representation under a new preregistration.
failure_policy.statistical_process_passes: Freeze its result as the non-neural baseline, then train conditional latent diffusion against it and the independent null.

claim_limit: Twelve named real-cave development sources support a constrained morphology-trajectory mechanism study, not a universal cave distribution, independent population estimate, causal speleogenesis model, or proof of realism in other geology.
